summary: R7 landed across the argo-cd/ set: O3 closes as D49 (one relay URL, Argo CD off the internet), design.md's webhook section describes the relay path and its contract, phases.md A.4 drops the self-contradicting 'expose argocd-server with homelab TLS; decide O3' bullet for an internal-UI bullet plus the relay deployment and A.5 gains 015's two live proof items, history.md carries why nginx mirror and the off-the-shelf relays lost, and D6/D22/D39 lose the clauses the fan-out falsified; AnsibleSpecs/README.md gains 015's pending entry (linked-bullet convention, so close-out moves it by hand as with 008) and repoints 009's link. DockerImages README's refusal table now states what the mux actually does (HEAD /healthz -> 200, non-canonical paths -> 307), re-probed against the shipped code, closing close-out B2's documentation half; close-out.md gained its summary, focus lines and S4 (pending slices still quote the pre-relay set). Homelab decisions.md, docs/runbooks/ and /work/Ansible needed nothing — no standing rule moved and no runbook names this behaviour; /work/Ansible has no commit for this slice. Gates green: cexec go go test -count=1 ./... and gofmt -l in webhook-relay/src, cexec iac ./scripts/arch-validate.py */architecture.yaml (23/23), and kc project lint/build/test in /work/Ansible — logged to doc_gate_r1.log. Committed on AnsibleSpecs main (files staged by name: cfb53ee) and DockerImages main (f78afee); NEITHER PUSHED — the DockerImages commit sits ahead of origin/main and needs the operator's push, since the driver only pushes the Ansible branch. Architecture-model nudge: the docker-images producer gained a new SoftwareProduct (webhook-relay), hand-authored and validating, but no consumption edge toward the two Argo receivers — Argo CD is modelled by no producer yet, so 009's ArgoCDDeploy is where that edge belongs (close-out S2); the Ansible model is untouched — no host, daemon or external identity moved.
